Lemma
[Differentiability of the convolution series in coordinates] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0258 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-parametrix-error-derivatives ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-convolution-estimates 1. ch23:23.23\group Convolution

On compact coordinate sets and $[0,T]$, if $N>n/2+2\ell +m$, then \[ \sum _{k\ge 1}\partial _t^\ell \partial _x^m(\Box _xP_N)^{*k} \] converges absolutely and uniformly, and equals $\partial _t^\ell \partial _x^mG_N$.
Proof

\sketch Differentiate the first factor of each convolution. The derivative estimate has time exponent $N-n/2-2\ell -m>-1$; convolving with the majorant in Lemma 2 yields a factorially summable bound, uniformly on compact sets.

□
